comments.body_html:
The Default delay and all other time markers can be adjusted. Your delay between starts is System/Hardware Dependent, on our end, we have our Delay at 45 Seconds. The more Mods you have, or the older your System, the Higher the number(s) need to be, generally speaking.

In terms of implementing the actual Server Log that SPT.Server.exe Opens into the UI itself, if I understand you right, I have tried this and been meant with Server errors every time. Not saying it isn’t possible, but right now that is not something I am working towards, potentially in the future.

If you downloaded 2.0, the UI is far superior to 1.7. It is not perfect, it is very basic, but it is designed to be as minimalistic as possible. Regardless, thank you for the feedback. I will be continuing the Update this over time. In the near future, I may look further into the Idea of hooking the actual Server and Headless Command Windows into the Program. Just not sure of the viability of that at the moment.

This Program is designed and intended for always on Systems that run Headless Clients and the Server, hence why I wasn’t too concerned with beautifying the process too much.

comments.author: NOCTIDE
comments.body_html:
So, I attempted this idea (again) and unfortunately, SPT.Server.exe cannot be ran this way because the Launcher quite literally expects the Console that normally opens and appears to be opened. Piping the entire thing into WATCHDOG itself, and not allowing the normal Server Console to open is simply not viable. As for the Headless, while it may allow it’s output to be piped into WATCHDOG, the Headless normally launches a couple of Child Processes/Windows, at least while it is Launching, this not only just makes it sort of a pain to Pipe everything into the Program at once with it being accurate and legible, but also would be a maintenance nightmare (for me.)

The closest equivalent I could implement is allowing the SPT Processes to automatically Minimize themselves, and then Mirror their outputs into WATCHDOG. I may do this, I may not. Either way, I appreciate your idea and figured it was worth another shot.

Hello everyone, just figured I would kind of put a briefing of where I am at regarding the App and its development in the Future.

May 31, 2025. Frankly speaking, I have stepped away entirely from working on this App. It is finished and carries out everything I expected it to. While I was experimenting with a Companion Plugin, and planning to add Custom Restart Times, I simply haven’t been working on it at all for Months now, both because I haven’t wanted to, and because of some recent Major Life Changes that took me out of doing it, with no Plans to come back to this App in particular just to add a few very minor things. On top of all of this, myself and the folks I usually play the Game with have been on a bit of an extended Hiatus from SPT/Tarkov in general.

So, for now, this is it. I will be in the Support Server still taking Reports, however, barring any massive Changes to the Game or some wild Miracle, the App has proven to be Stable, so any Reports of Minor Issues are unlikely to addressed with swiftness if it appears to be a Bug that is only occurring within a small subset of User Environments.

Thanks everyone who has downloaded, reported Bugs or Issues, or is currently using the App. I hope it is proving as useful for everyone out there who could use it as it is for myself and my Friends. Despite being on a Months Long Hiatus from the Game, our Server is still going strong with periodic Restarts, as expected, through WATCHDOG.

comments.author: NOCTIDE
comments.body_html:
Hello! Firstly, thank you very much for the kind words, I really appreciate it, and I am very glad it is helping some People with true Remote Setups have a bit of an easier time, as intended! As for your questions and ideas:

  1. In terms of a Custom Restart Time, that is actually a really good idea, and I am not sure why I never thought of that before. Although I intended on 2.1.2 pretty much being the final release, because MY Vision was fulfilled, I like this idea and I think I am going to look into it, because I could see how that would be a really nice QoL Improvement on top of what the App already provides.

  2. As for whether or not the App checks for players online prior to Restart, the answer is no. WATCHDOG is a very simple Program, and whatever Time it is set to restart, it is going to restart. This is the reason why I implemented Discord Webhooking into it, so that People could at least know when next restart was if they did not have access to the Host Machine. I have kind of been racking my Brains about trying to see if there would be a way to smoothly implement a way for me to do this, I need to be careful to not overdo it and turn it into a maintenance nightmare for myself and Users, thus turning it into another grind for quick patches and such to ensure UX.

  3. As for Hooking Restart Notifs into the Game, again, this kind of has been the thing I have been racking my Brain about recently. I am NOT Experienced with Code like what Tarkov runs off of, and Tarkov’s Code is obfuscated as of 1.0, hence why the App is entirely separate from the Game. However, it is possible that I can look into a basic System, but by no means guaranteed. Maybe an in game Bot that Messages you? Not sure.

I want to be clear and say I am not guaranteeing anything, but the idea of a better, more explicit Notification System for not only the Host but for all users of the Server that is being Managed by WATCHDOG is something I have been thinking about, I am just weighing time investment vs. outcome, as building this obviously took plenty of real hours out of my real life, and I am happy with 2.1.2, frankly. Checking for Players Online is a great idea on paper, but implementing it may not be so simple (as is often the case), so again, I must stress reliability and UX over convenience at some point, considering the purpose of the App.

Thanks again for the kind words, I really appreciate it. If you run into any issues please do not hesitate to join the Discord and shoot a ticket over so I can look into it, I need all the data I can get! Enjoy.
